item.title: Indie Brief, Wednesday 30 September
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Wednesday 30 September.
Modern Times Review has an interview with Gediminas Andriukaitis about Inconvenient Films, the Baltic region's only human rights documentary festival.
